columns.reason: Plano 2B stores each reservation's service turn and the owner authorization metadata needed for capacity and schedule exceptions.

constraints.reason: Plano 2B requires an actor and timestamp whenever an exception reason is stored.

indexes.reason: Plano 2B indexes active, non-walk-in reservations by date and service turn, plus the override audit lookup.

policies.reason: Plano 2B restricts exception-audit reads to the dono role.

triggers.reason: Plano 2B classifies a reservation before enforcing service capacity and records approved overrides.

tables_rls_grants.reason: Plano 2B adds the RLS-protected reservation_override_audits table and its owner read grant.

public.check_daily_capacity.reason: Plano 2B applies an advisory-locked capacity of 80 per date and service turn, excludes walk-ins, and fails closed for unclassified history.

public.validate_reservation_schedule.reason: Plano 2B permits an out-of-schedule reservation only when an owner authorization was recorded.

public.is_reservation_owner.reason: Plano 2B introduces the dedicated dono authorization predicate.

public.set_reservation_service_period.reason: Plano 2B snapshots a reservation's service turn and requires a valid reference turn for schedule exceptions.

public.record_reservation_override_audit.reason: Plano 2B writes the actor, reason, date, turn and capacity effect of approved exceptions.

public.get_reservation_capacity_availabi.reason: Plano 2B returns capacity by public booking slot and service turn.

public.reservation_service_start_is_avai.reason: Plano 2B validates the explicit reference turn used by an out-of-schedule exception.

public.create_reservation_with_owner_ove.reason: Plano 2B creates audited capacity and schedule exceptions only for the dono role.

public.classify_reservation_service_peri.reason: Plano 2B lets the dono resolve an explicitly reviewed historical reservation without guessing its turn.

public.replace_reservation_table_assignm.reason: Follow-up hardening requires active tables in active areas and serializes assignments against changes to those active flags.
